note: Spells are cast from either hand. kind: stream (held, cost per second) | self (held, heals) | remembrance (Z, cooldown). Remembrances are learned from word walls.

flames.name: Flames
flames.desc: A gout of fire. Deals {damage} fire damage per second; costs {cost} magicka per second.

healing.name: Healing
healing.desc: Heals {heal} health per second while held; costs {cost} magicka per second.

recall.name: Recall
recall.desc: Speak the word and the world remembers itself: forgotten objects and paths within 40 m shimmer into sight for 10 seconds.
